# dahrouj.com

> Mohamed Dahrouj is a full-service real estate sales representative with Right at Home Realty, Brokerage, based in the Glebe, Ottawa, Ontario. He helps people sell, buy and lease homes across Ottawa, relocate to Ottawa for work, settle as newcomers to Canada, move on Canadian Armed Forces postings, and buy cottages near Ottawa.

- Office: 14 Chamberlain Ave, Suite 101, Ottawa, ON K1S 1V9 (Right at Home Realty, Brokerage)
- Mobile: 613-869-5923 · Office: 613-369-5199 · Email: mohamed@dahrouj.com
- Areas served: Ottawa, including Kanata, Stittsville, Barrhaven, Findlay Creek, Riverside South, Orléans, Manotick, Westboro and the Glebe; cottages in the Rideau Lakes, Lanark County, Calabogie and the Ottawa Valley
- Fees: published upfront as a FairFee™ agent: 1.5% listing brokerage fee and 2% to the buyer's brokerage, full service
